About QASADAN

We are a team of designers, engineers, and strategists building the digital face of East African organizations — and proving every day that world-class technology is made here.

Our Story

Built in Mogadishu, for the world

QASADAN began in 2020 with a simple frustration: talented organizations across the Horn of Africa were being underserved by the digital industry. Schools ran on paper notices, research institutes were invisible online, and businesses lost customers to competitors with nothing more than a decent website.

Our founders — a designer and an engineer — set out to close that gap. Not by importing generic templates, but by building a genuine product studio rooted in the region: one that understands local realities like mobile-first audiences, intermittent connectivity, and multilingual communities, while delivering to international standards.

Today, QASADAN has delivered over fifty digital projects for schools, NGOs, startups, and enterprises. Every one of them shares the same foundation: rigorous engineering, honest design, and a partnership mindset that keeps clients coming back.

Our Mission

To empower East African organizations with digital products of global standard — accessible, fast, and built to grow — so that geography is never a barrier to opportunity.

Our Vision

A Horn of Africa where every school, business, and institution operates at full digital potential — with QASADAN as the engine behind thousands of those success stories.

Our Values

The principles behind every project

Values are only real if they change how you work. These four shape every decision we make.

Craft over shortcuts

We believe quality is non-negotiable. Every line of code, every pixel, and every interaction is deliberate — because your reputation deserves nothing less.

Partnership over transactions

We succeed when you succeed. That is why most of our work comes from repeat clients and referrals — we treat your project like our own product.

Trust through transparency

Clear timelines, honest pricing, and open communication. You will always know exactly where your project stands and what happens next.

Growth minded

We build for where you are going, not just where you are. Scalable architecture and maintainable code are standard on every engagement.

Our Journey

Milestones along the way

  1. 2020

    QASADAN is founded

    Started as a two-person studio in Mogadishu with a single conviction: world-class digital work can be made in Somalia.

  2. 2022

    First institutional client

    Delivered our first large-scale institutional website, establishing QASADAN as a trusted partner for NGOs and schools.

  3. 2024

    Team expands to 10+

    Grew our design, engineering, and support teams and formalized our junior mentorship programme.

  4. 2026

    New Digital Lab opens

    Opened our dedicated Digital Lab — usability testing, QA, and training under one roof.
